visual.alt: Ground floor and first floor plan of the Weavers' Yard museum. Main entrance (Bridge Street), ticket desk, corridor, weaving gallery, cloakroom, stairs, first-floor temporary exhibition gallery, the stairs' upward direction and north arrow are labelled; eight locations lettered A-H are left unlabelled.

items.evidence: Opposite the café, on your right, is the shop
items.explanation: The shop is directly opposite the café, on the right of the entrance; the cloakroom is already labelled by name on the plan, so there's no risk of confusing them.

items.evidence: between the lecture theatre and the shop there's a lift
items.explanation: The lift is between the lecture theatre and the shop; since the cloakroom and stairs in between are already labelled on the plan, only one location is left.

items.evidence: the reading room, at the top of the stairs on your right
items.explanation: The reading room is upstairs, the room to the right at the top of the stairs; the upward direction of the stairs is shown with an arrow on the plan.
